content_sections.heading: About IIT Jammu
content_sections.text: IIT Jammu (Indian Institute of Technology Jammu) is a technical institute in Jammu. It has a Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) that runs a Water Testing Lab (WQTL), which tests water from the institute's Jagti and Paloura campuses and from outside organisations. The Outsource Agency is hiring the selected candidate and will depute them to work at IIT Jammu.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Project Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the post is 37 years. Candidates must meet one of the following two conditions: M. Tech degree in Environmental Engineering/Chemical Engineering or allied engineering branches with at least one year of relevant experience in Academics (Teaching post), NABL /accredited laboratory /research facility / industry and 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying degree from a recognized University/ Institute. M.Sc. degree in Environmental Sciences / Chemistry or equivalent qualification in appropriate field with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in Academics (Teaching post), NABL /accredited laboratory /research facility / industry and 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying degree from a recognized University/Institute. Good knowledge of computer applications is also a must. This covers email, word processing, spreadsheets, presentation software and operating systems such as MS-Windows. Preference goes to candidates with hands-on experience of equipment such as GC-MS, HPLC, Spectrophotometer and Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometer. The official notification gives the full eligibility for the post, so check it before applying.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Project Officer
content_sections.text: The Project Officer will manage the water testing lab at the Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) of IIT Jammu. The work includes tests on water quality parameters such as pH, conductivity, hardness, BOD, COD and heavy metals, including testing in the field. The officer will also handle 2-3 major scientific instruments at the CIF lab. The key responsibilities are: Each month, collecting samples of drinking water and waste water from 60 water filters and 6 STPs on the Jagti and Paloura campuses. Testing these samples for 10+ water quality parameters in triplicate and writing a report every month. External sampling when the WQTL receives requests. Field sampling as needed, for both external and internal samples. Operating the major sophisticated equipment in the WQTL, mainly gas chromatography, ion chromatography, atomic absorption spectrophotometry and ICP-MS. Maintaining the equipment at the WQTL, IIT Jammu. Other related work, such as processing bills and raising indents.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a Trade Test/Interaction. Having the qualifications does not guarantee a place on the shortlist. The Institute may set a cut-off higher than the minimum to keep the number of candidates reasonable. Candidates must bring all their original documents for verification at the Trade Test/Interaction.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Period of engagement: 1 year, extendable each year based on performance and need. Nature of engagement: outsource basis. The Outsource Agency will depute the selected candidate to IIT Jammu. This is a purely temporary engagement. Being selected gives no claim to regularisation against any regular post, or against any future vacancy in any cadre or post at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q1. Can an M.Sc. Chemistry graduate apply for the IIT Jammu Project Officer post?
faq.answer: Yes. An M.Sc. in Environmental Sciences or Chemistry (or an equivalent qualification) is accepted. It must come with at least 2 years of relevant experience and 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q2. How much experience does an M.Tech candidate need?
faq.answer: At least one year of relevant experience. It can be from teaching, an NABL or accredited laboratory, a research facility or industry.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of the Project Officer at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary package is Rs. 45,000-55,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age to apply?
Q5. Is this a permanent job at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary engagement on outsource basis for 1 year, extendable each year. It gives no claim to regularisation at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q6. Which instruments will the Project Officer work with?
faq.answer: Mainly gas chromatography, ion chromatography, atomic absorption spectrophotometry and ICP-MS in the Water Testing Lab. Candidates with hands-on experience of GC-MS or HPLC get preference.

faq.question: Q7. How many water sources will the Project Officer sample?
faq.answer: Every month, 60 water filters and 6 STPs on the Jagti and Paloura campuses. Each sample is tested for 10+ parameters in triplicate.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for a Trade Test/Interaction. The Institute may use a cut-off higher than the minimum for shortlisting.

faq.question: Q9. Which educational details must be filled in the online form?
faq.answer: Details of the 10th or equivalent, 12th or equivalent, graduation and post-graduation (if any). An incomplete application will be rejected.
